caption: The video captures an outdoor grassy field at twilight, bordered by a distant line of bare trees beneath a soft gradient sky. In the foreground sits a circular red-brick fire pit, heaped with evergreen pine and cedar boughs that spill over its rim. From the center of this green mound, a bright orange-yellow flame already burns, its base anchored within the branches while the surrounding field slopes gently toward the tree line. The flame flickers continuously, its shape and height varying from moment to moment. At times it rises as a tall, narrow column; at others it spreads into a bushier, split plume with separate tongues of fire reaching higher into the cool air. The upper portions billow, lean, and re-form, casting a warm glow on the nearby boughs. Faint smoke drifts above the brightest flames, while the base stays put within the pile. The brick pit, greenery, and tree line hold their positions through a largely steady view, the burn continuing without pause.
